messages:
Ivy: flag 1 — noticed several customers seeing negative 'unit cost' on the cost dashboard after cache credits. PMs are confused. :confused:
Noah: saw it on /v1/generate too. looks like prefetch amortization + late refund stacking.
Rae: repro on staging (quick):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","chain":["edge","nlg"],"prefetch":true}'
```
Tomas: short-term UX: show both columns "raw token cost" and "net after credits" side-by-side. default to net, but if net < 0 show a subtle warning and a link "why negative?".
Ivy: data change: we only emit cache_credit number today. propose adding optional credit_source (enum) + small lineage_id (8-char hex) and keep them optional to avoid cardinality.
Noah: cardinality worry acknowledged. propose deterministic sampling by tenant_id at 2% default, 100% for canaries/org-paid. sampled events include lineage fields.
Rae: console needs an endpoint that returns raw_series + adjusted_series and a toggle (include amortized credits). also add CTA "show sampled traces" that queries trace endpoint when lineage_id exists.
Tomas: ops: exclude canary traffic from amortization pools (treat canaries as cold) so experiments don't skew tenant economics. also add an alert: if route 95p net_cost < 0 for > 10m -> dry-run then page.
Ivy: action items: (1) Ivy open RFC for canary exclusion + alert runbook. (2) Rae mock UI + endpoint contract. (3) Noah PR for sampling config + storage estimate. (4) Tomas small schema PR adding optional credit_source, lineage_id, explicit cache_credit numeric.
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.14.6 deployed to staging (hash: f9e8d7c)
Noah: tests passing locally for sampling adapter, will link PR in ~30m.
Rae: will post UI mock in #design later today.
Ivy: thanks all, sync in 20 for quick handoff. :thumbsup:
